Free AI Toolbox — 64 personally tested recommendations

AI Tools · Personal Tests and Recommendations · 8 Major Categories · Free Quotas · VPN Explanations · Recommended to Bookmark

It’s 2026, and if you haven’t started using AI tools in your daily work, you’re really wasting your time.

The question isn’t ‘whether to use it,’ but 'which one to use—there are tons of recommendations online, but which ones are truly free? Which ones require VPN access? Is the free version enough?

I spent two months personally testing 64 AI tools, organizing this list into 8 major scenarios. Each tool is marked with free limits, whether you need a VPN, and what suits you best.

All information is based on actual testing in April 2026, and the free policy may be adjusted at any time.

1. AI Writing / Chat (8 models)

This is the first step for most people to get involved with AI. Choosing the right chatbot can instantly double your writing efficiency.

Tools Free quota VPN The most suitable choice
ChatGPT (GPT-4o mini) There is a free quota every day Yes Daily Q&A, writing, translation
Claude (Sonnet) There is a free quota every day Yes Writing long articles, analysis, programming
DeepSeek Completely free and unlimited No need Reasoning and analysis, Chinese writing, mathematics
Kimi Completely free No need Long document reading, web summary
Wenxin Yiyan The basic version is free No need Chinese writing and PPT outlines
A thousand questions about the meaning of the classics The basic version is free No need Multimodal, code generation
Gemini The free version is available Yes Multimodal (image/video understanding)
Copilot Free (Microsoft account required) Yes Internet search + GPT-4 conversation

For domestic users, DeepSeek + Kimi are the first choices—completely free, no need to bypass the firewall, and excellent Chinese skills. Use Claude or ChatGPT when you need to write English.

2. AI Image Generation (7 models)

No worries if you don’t know how to draw—AI will help you draw. From logos to illustrations to photo-quality images, these tools can handle it all.

Tools Free quota VPN The most suitable choice
Midjourney 25 sheets/month (trial for new accounts) Yes Artistic style, high-quality illustrations
DALL-E 3 Monthly free quota Yes Precise text rendering and creative drawings
Stable Diffusion Completely free (on-premises deployment) No need Maximum freedom and customizable models
Ideogram Daily free quota Yes Text posters and logo design
Leonardo AI 150 tokens/day No need Game assets and character design
Understand the principles of myriad aspects Free quota No need Chinese scenes, e-commerce images
Wenxin has a unique style Free quota No need Chinese-style illustrations, Chinese posters

For image quality, use Midjourney; for freedom, use Stable Diffusion for local deployment; for domestic users, use Tongyi Wanxiang or Wenxin Yige.

3. AI Video Generation (5 models)

Text-to-video, image-to-video—AI video tools will be available by 2026.

Tools Free quota VPN The most suitable choice
Runway Gen-3 125 credits/month Yes Text-to-video, video editing
Kling Daily free quota No need Domestic video generation, Chinese scenarios
Pika Daily free quota Yes Short videos, animations, stylization
Tencent Hunyuan Free trial No need Domestic video generation and Chinese understanding
Conch AI (MiniMax) Free quota No need Video generation and speech synthesis

Domestic users should choose Keling (produced by Kuaishou), with ample free credit and good Chinese comprehension. Runway is a global benchmark, with the best graphics but requires VPN access.

4. AI Programming Assistants (5 models)

A productivity tool for programmers. Can’t write code? AI helps you write. Can write code? AI helps you write faster.

Tools Free quota VPN The most suitable choice
Cursor Free version available (2000 completed/month) Yes AI-native IDEs and full-stack development
GitHub Copilot Student/Open source: Free Yes Code completion and VS Code integration
Codeium Unlimited personal free Optional Code completion and multilingual support
Tabnine The basic version is free No need Local operation, privacy first
Windsurf The free version is available Yes AI programming, Cascade workflows

For daily programming, I recommend Cursor for the free version—the most complete experience. If you don’t want to bypass the firewall, use Codeium or Tabnine, but the features are sufficient.

5. AI Music Generation (2 models)

Writing a song is no longer just musicians’ domain. Enter a description, and AI will generate the complete song—with vocals and arrangement.

Tools Free quota VPN The most suitable choice
Suno 50 credits/day (about 10 songs) No need Songs in all styles, Chinese songs
Udio 10 credits/day Yes High-quality music and a variety of styles

Suno has excellent Chinese support, with 10 free tracks per day, more than enough for background music or entertainment. Udio’s sound quality is more refined but requires a VPN to use.

6. AI Translation (3 models)

Machine translation is no longer enough. AI translation understands context, and the translation quality approaches human level.

Tools Free quota VPN The most suitable choice
DeepL 500,000 characters per month No need Academic papers, professional translation
Immersive translation The basic version is free No need Bilingual webpage support and real-time translation
Tencent Translator 5 million characters per month No need Chinese scenarios and document translation

Install ‘immersive translation’ for English web pages, use DeepL for document translation, and use Tencent Translate for Chinese-related scenarios. Installing all three is still not a loss.

7. AI PPT / Office (4 models)

Making PPTs is the most time-consuming. AI can help you generate everything from outline to design with one click, saving 80% of the time.

Tools Free quota VPN The most suitable choice
Gamma 400 AI credits (about 10 PPT files) Yes One-click PPT generation with strong design sense
iFlytek Zhiwen The free version is available No need Chinese PPT and speech drafts are generated
iSlide The basic version is free No need PPT plugins and one-click layout
Beautiful.ai The basic version is free Yes Business presentations and automatic layout

For Chinese PPTs, iFlytek Zhiwen is the first choice—free and easy to use. For English presentations, use Gamma or Beautiful.ai, which has a stronger sense of design.

8. AI Search (3 models)

Traditional search engines give you a bunch of links, but AI search gives you the answer directly. This is a generational upgrade in search methods.

Tools Free quota VPN The most suitable choice
Perplexity 5 Pro searches per day Yes In-depth research brings source citations
Mita AI search Free and unlimited No need Chinese search and academic research
Quark Free of charge No need Daily search and document Q&A

In China, using Mita AI search is free and unlimited, and you can also search academic papers. If you need to search for English materials, use Perplexity, which offers the highest quality answers.

Summary: Recommended by scenario

  • ✍️ Writing articles / chatting :D eepSeek (preferred in China) + Claude (preferred in English)

  • 🎨 Drawing / Design: Tongyi Wanxiang (Domestic) + Midjourney (Best Image Quality)

  • 🎬 Video Making: Keling (the strongest in China) + Runway (global benchmark)

  • 💻 Coding: Cursor (best experience) + Codeium (no VPN required)

  • 🎵 Making Music: Suno (Best Chinese songs, free every day)

  • 🌍 Translation: Immersive Translation (Webpage) + DeepL (Document)

  • 📊 Making PPTs: iFlytek Zhiwen (Chinese) + Gamma (English)

  • 🔍 Search: Mita AI Search (Domestic) + Perplexity (Global)

64 tools across 8 major scenarios, all with free plans. **Pick the one that best suits your needs and try it out first—it’s more useful than collecting 100 tools. **
